name: harness-team
description: Run every work task as a five-role harness team: a lead who never asks what the goal is, fixes the last task's mistakes first and keeps simple work itself, an obsessive perfectionist final reviewer it calls in (always for risky work), and a carry-over ledger.

interface.shortDescription: Five-role team with a lead-called perfectionist review and carry-over fixes
interface.longDescription: A lead infers the goal without asking and first fixes the previous task's mistakes; simple work stays with the lead, other work goes to a scout, builder and verifier; when the lead calls for review (always for risky work), an obsessive perfectionist reviews it once and every finding is applied right away; findings that cannot be applied and the lead's own mistakes carry over.
defaultPrompt: Run this task as the harness team.
